summary: The study demonstrates the band alignment of BeO gate dielectric grown by atomic-layer deposition (ALD) on AlGaN/GaN HEMTs. The bandgap of the BeO film was measured to be 8.2 ± 0.05 eV, and the valence band offset was determined to be 1.1 ± 0.1 eV. The conduction band offset was calculated to be 3.2 ± 0.1 eV. The BeO-gated AlGaN/GaN HEMT showed an improved on/off current ratio of 107, indicating its potential as a gate dielectric for GaN-based high-power devices.
evidence: The bandgap of the BeO film was measured to be 8.2 ± 0.05 eV by reflection electron energy loss spectroscopy. A valence band offset of the BeO/AlGaN interface was determined to be 1.1 ± 0.1 eV by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. Based on the spectral analysis result, the conduction band offset was calculated to be 3.2 ± 0.1 eV. When BeO was used as the gate dielectric of an AlGaN/GaN transistor, the on/off current ratio was improved to 107.
